name: Phil
intro: Hi, I’m Phil — a curious AI builder and designer.
about: My exploration began with architectural design and gradually moved toward the intersection of AIGC, interaction design, and the internet.

I enjoy working with AI to clarify fuzzy ideas and turn them into useful things. Formulasearch is my personal practice hub: a place for the projects I am making, blog posts, Skills, and tools I want to share. Some come from independent exploration; others are made with collaborators.
interest: Outside of vibe coding, I also enjoy photography and travel, and occasionally share the images and fragments I record along the way.
sponsor: If something I share is useful to you, you are welcome to buy me a coffee. Thank you.
